why: No major reviewer answers RV boondocking under $1,000: OutdoorGearLab and TechRadar are general category lists whose off-grid picks sit above budget. The rest are affiliate listicles and niche spec-comparison pages that answer only half the question (RV without budget, or budget without RV), with testing nobody can check. Mirrors the solar-kit win: a focused page with current prices, tested codes and a clear pick would stand out.
